photoperiod.name: Photoperiod
photoperiod.description: Classic seeds, approx. 16 weeks. Flowering starts with the 12/12 light switch.

autoflower.description: Automatic flowering, approx. 11 weeks. Light stays at 18 hours.

confirmations.startFlowering: Ready for flowering? From now on the light runs 12/12 — confirm to start the switch.
confirmations.harvest: Check the trichomes: milky with first amber tones? Then harvest and confirm — drying starts next.
confirmations.dryingDone: Do the branches snap instead of bending? Then drying is done — off to the curing jars.

assistant.confirmationPending: Your plan is waiting for a confirmation — open settings
assistant.deviationMonitorHint: Your device only monitors — adjust this manually in your setup.
assistant.bannerText: Let a grow plan guide you through the stages — targets adjust automatically, and you confirm the big steps.

seedling.1: Keep the medium slightly moist, never soaking wet — seedlings drown faster than they dry out.
seedling.2: High humidity (65–75 %) helps young roots; a propagator dome works great in the first days.
seedling.3: Keep the light dimmed (around 40 %) and at a good distance — bleached or curled leaves mean it's too strong.
seedling.4: Don't feed yet: the seed carries nutrients for the first two weeks.

vegetative.1: Water when the top few centimeters of the medium feel dry — lifting the pot tells you more than a schedule.
vegetative.2: Now is training time: topping or bending (LST) creates an even canopy and more bud sites.
vegetative.3: Raise light intensity step by step towards 80–100 % as the plants toughen up.
vegetative.4: Watch the VPD chart: 0.8–1.1 kPa keeps transpiration and growth in balance.

flowering.1: Keep humidity at or below 50 % — dense buds plus high humidity is how mold starts.
flowering.2: Don't change the light schedule anymore; interruptions of the dark period stress photoperiod plants.
flowering.3: Feed bloom nutrients and watch leaf color — fading towards the end is normal.
flowering.4: Check the trichomes in the last weeks: cloudy with the first amber ones usually means harvest time.

drying.1: 16–20 °C and 55–60 % humidity, dark and with gentle air movement — slow drying preserves the terpenes.
drying.2: Plan for 10–14 days. If it's done after 5, it was too warm or too dry.
drying.3: The snap test: when small branches crack instead of bending, the buds are ready for curing jars.
drying.4: Open the jars daily in the first curing week ('burping') to let moisture escape.

lightOutput.title: Light output
lightOutput.saved: Stored and sent. The device acknowledges no setting, so what it is running is the level above.
lightOutput.noSettings: This device has not sent its settings yet, so there is nothing to write a brightness into. It sends them when it next connects.
lightOutput.needsFirmware: This build cannot be told to hold its light output. The brightness still reaches it — that is a setting and not a command.
lightOutput.keptForLater: Nothing is listening, so the buttons reach nobody — a brightness is stored all the same, and the device is handed it when it connects again.
lightOutput.explained: The device dims this output itself and ramps it through sunrise and sunset; the brightness is the most it gives. A smart socket with a light role has no level of its own — it follows this output on or off, unless it is being held. Hours of light count every hour the lamp is above zero, so dimming changes how bright the day is and not how long it is.

message-device-booted:POWERON-text: Your device has rebooted. The reason was a power cycle (POWERON) - this is normal after unplugging or a power outage. If this message appears unexpectedly please check your power connection.
message-device-booted:BROWNOUT-text: Your device has rebooted. The reason was a brownout: the supply voltage dropped below the safe threshold. This usually means the power adapter or USB cable cannot deliver enough current.
message-device-booted:TASK_WDT-text: Your device has rebooted. The reason was a task watchdog timeout: the main firmware loop did not respond in time and was force-restarted. This typically happens when network operations get stuck on a flaky internet uplink. If this message appears regularly please check your internet connection.

message-device-booted:WDT-text: Your device has rebooted. The reason was an internal watchdog timeout. Please report this to support if it happens repeatedly.
message-device-booted:PANIC-text: Your device has rebooted. The reason was a firmware crash (panic) - the device restarted automatically. Please report this to support if it happens repeatedly.
message-device-booted:SW-text: Your device has rebooted. The reason was an intentional software-triggered restart (for example after a configuration change or firmware update).
message-device-booted:EXT-text: Your device has rebooted. The reason was a hardware reset via the reset pin.
message-device-booted:DEEPSLEEP-text: Your device has rebooted. The reason was a wake-up from deep sleep mode.
message-device-booted:SDIO-text: Your device has rebooted. The reason was a restart over the SDIO interface.
message-device-booted:UNKNOWN-text: Your device has rebooted. The reason was not reported by the device. If this message appears regularly please check your power connection and internet uplink.
message-device-booted:REMOTE-text: Your device has rebooted. The reason was an intentional restart triggered remotely via the portal.

later.devices: Every controller, camera and smart socket standing here, with its role and its switch.
later.members: Who can log and who can manage here, and the invites that bring them in.

control.title: Grow plan
control.noController: Nothing stands here for a plan to run on. A plan writes its steps to a controller, so one has to be claimed into this tent first.
control.none: This controller is not being run by a plan.
control.noneNote: A plan is a list of steps: a stage, how long it lasts, and what the tent should hold while it does. Saving one does not start it.
control.noSteps: This plan has no steps, so there is nothing for it to run.
control.openEnded: runs until it is moved on

waiting.title: Waiting for you
waiting.noMessage: The step asks to be confirmed and left no message.
waiting.since: Standing still for {{age}}: the plan goes no further until it is confirmed.

next.loops: Next · back to step 1, {{name}} — this plan loops.
next.ends: This is the last step: the plan completes when it is over.
next.completed: Every step has run. Starting it again begins at step 1.

applied.at: Step sent to the controller {{age}} ago
applied.never: This step has not been sent to the controller yet
applied.atRest: The controller is left running the settings the last step gave it
applied.quiet: the controller has said nothing for {{age}}, so what it is running may be older than this

ask.extend: More time on the step the tent is on. The step keeps the length it was written with and only its clock is put back, so a step that had already asked to be confirmed asks again when the longer time is up.
ask.skip: The plan moves on to step {{number}}, {{name}}, and starts its clock. What this step still had to run is not kept.
ask.skipEnds: This is the last step, so skipping it completes the plan. The controller keeps the settings this step gave it.
ask.stop: The plan keeps its steps and stands at the first one again, ready to be started. The controller keeps the settings the last step gave it: stopping says nothing about what the tent should be doing instead.

editor.title: Edit the plan
editor.name: Name
editor.loopNote: A plan that loops never completes: the last step is followed by the first.
editor.noSteps: No steps yet. A plan without them has nothing to run.

step.name: Name
step.stageNote: The stage is what the step puts the grow standing here into, with the day counter and the diary line that go with it. A step with no stage leaves the phase where it is.
step.openEndedNote: A step of no length runs until somebody moves it on by hand.
step.writesNothing: This step writes nothing: the controller keeps whatever it was running when the step began.
step.writesSections: A step writes whole sections of the controller's settings: the day and night targets, the CO₂ target and the light's limit. A section it does not touch is left as it is, and a figure left empty takes its section's other figures with it.
step.alsoWrites: This step also carries settings this screen does not edit ({{sections}}); they are kept as they are.
step.takeFromController: Take what the controller holds now
step.waitsNote: When its time is up the plan stands still and asks, rather than moving on by itself.
step.message: What to say when it asks

notify.label: When it moves on
notify.emailNote: Left empty, the plan writes to the address this account signs in with.
notify.writeEntriesNote: A step change leaves a line on the tent's timeline, whether or not a mail goes out.

effect.newPlan: This controller is being run by nothing, so the plan is saved at rest. Starting it is a separate tap.
effect.atRest: This plan is not running, so saving moves nothing: starting it begins at step 1.
effect.empties: A plan without steps has nothing to run, so it stops and the controller keeps what the last step gave it.
effect.stays: The tent goes on running {{name}} as step {{number}}, with the time it has already served.
effect.moves: {{name}} is the step the tent is on: it moves from {{from}} to {{to}} and keeps the time it has already served.
effect.relength: Its new length is measured against that time, so a step that has already served longer than it now lasts is over at once.
effect.restarts: {{gone}} is the step the tent is on and it is gone from the list, so {{starts}} takes its place as step {{number}} and starts from zero. A confirmation it was waiting for is forgotten.
effect.resends: The step's settings are sent to the controller again within the next minute rather than at the next hour.

refused.nothing_to_confirm: This step is not waiting to be confirmed: it has been answered already, or its time is not up yet.
refused.plan_not_running: This plan is not running any more, so it has no step to move.
refused.plan_not_found: This controller is not being run by a plan any more.
refused.plan_has_no_steps: A plan without steps has nothing to run. Write a step first.
refused.invalid_duration: A step is extended by a length greater than zero.
refused.duplicate_step_id: Two steps of this plan carry the same id, so nothing was saved. Close the sheet and open it again.
refused.plan_template_name_taken: You already have a template with that name. Give this one another.

template.name: Name
template.keepNote_one: The {{count}} step of this plan is copied as it stands. The plan and the template know nothing of each other afterwards.
template.keepNote_other: All {{count}} steps of this plan are copied as they stand. The plan and the template know nothing of each other afterwards.
template.publishNote: A published template can be read and copied by every account; it stays yours to change and to throw away.
template.startNote: Choosing one opens the plan with its steps in it. Nothing is written until it is saved, and what a save does to a tent that is already running is said there.
template.none: No templates yet. Keeping the plan on a tent as one is how the first is made.

verdict.noTarget: No target here · nothing to judge the day against
verdict.noReadings: Nothing heard in the last 24 h · nothing to judge the day by

presets.title: Climate preset · {{name}}
presets.writesClimateOnly: A preset writes the target climate and nothing else: temperature and humidity for day and night, the CO₂ target, and how long the light stays on. The work mode, the heating and dehumidifying behaviour, the fans and the dimming ramps are what this tent is tuned to and stay as they are.
presets.noClimateRow: Curing has no climate of its own — jars are not steered — so applying it writes nothing to anything standing here.
presets.nothingToWriteTo: Nothing standing here states a climate, so there is nothing to write one to.
presets.noPhaseFollows: No grow stands here, so no phase is written. The climate is written either way, and you are asked afterwards what should happen to the grow.
presets.wroteNothing: Nothing here took the climate: no controller standing here states one.
presets.wroteNothingCuring: Nothing was written to any controller: curing has no climate to write.

plan.skipped: The plan running here was moved on to its next step, which carries the same stage.
plan.paused: The plan running here was paused, so that it does not undo the preset within the hour.

presets.noGrowToMove: There is no other running grow to move here.
presets.startGrowLater: Starting a grow from here arrives with the new-grow sheet.
presets.question: The climate is written either way. What about the grow?

log.title: Log
log.oneTap: One tap logs it now with sensible defaults, Undo for 5 s, details optional. Photo opens the photo entry.
log.nowhere: Nothing to log against yet · start a grow or add a device first
log.noScheme: No feeding scheme here · what goes in the can is yours
log.mixOrder: Mix in this order · pH last · scheme values are a starting point, not a rule
log.phaseNeedsGrow: A phase belongs to a grow, and this line is about a place.
log.pictureAlt: The picture this line will carry
log.undoFailed: Could not take that line back

timeline.scrubber: Move the cursor through the window
timeline.noPanels: Nothing measures here, so there are no curves to draw
timeline.noSpaces: Nothing to draw yet. Add a device or start a grow on the

camera.noGrowHere: Nothing grows here, so there is no phase and no grow to film.
camera.needsPremium: HD and a film of a whole grow are part of Premium.
camera.askFailed: That film was not asked for.
camera.name: Name
camera.unpairSure: Its pictures stay where they are.
camera.unpairNote: Unpairing stops this camera being read. Every picture and film it has delivered keeps its link to it.

film.failedPlain: The render failed and gave no reason.
film.lost: That film could not be read.
film.queuedNote: Waiting for the builder, which takes the queue on its next pass. This page follows it; nothing is lost by leaving.

camera.noFilms: No film of this camera yet.

composer.title: Timelapse
composer.oneCameraHere: Only one camera stands here, so there is nothing to put beside it.
composer.backwards: A film ends after it begins; the second date has to be the later one.
composer.entriesHint: the diary lines of the span, on the frames around them

publicPage.footer: Terp Control: a controller in the tent writes the climate down, a camera takes the pictures, and the grower writes the rest.
publicPage.film: The whole grow, as a film
publicPage.noCameras: Camera pictures are not part of this
publicPage.nothingInWindow: Nothing in this stretch of the diary

window.all: You are reading all of it, up to now

noDiary.title: Nothing to read here
noDiary.body: There is no public diary at this address. Whether a diary has one is the grower's decision, and it is theirs to take back.

noProfile.title: Nobody here
noProfile.body: There is no public profile at this address.

deadLink.title: This address leads nowhere
deadLink.body: An address that is shared can be given an end, and one that has passed reads exactly like an address nobody ever made. If somebody sent you this one, ask them for a new one.

noPage.title: Nothing at this address
noPage.body: The app has no page here.

sharing.title: Share · {{name}}
sharing.publicPageNote: The diary gets an address of its own that anybody can open. Harvest weights and plant counts follow your privacy settings.
sharing.linksNote: A key for one person: a stretch of days, with or without the camera's pictures.
sharing.camerasNote: Without this the link carries the diary and its photos, but no still from the tent.

alarms.title: Alarms
alarms.noController: Nothing stands here that has alarm rules. A controller or a fridge module has to be claimed into this tent first.
alarms.footer: Silence and maintenance mode pause all of them; "in the tent" from the Log sheet does the same for 15 minutes.

sheet.title: Edit the alarm
sheet.name: Name
sheet.presetNote: The stage wrote this rule. The next stage writes its thresholds again, so what is changed here holds until then.
sheet.fractionNote: As a fraction of the time it runs: 0.5 is half the time.
sheet.noBound: Give it a line to cross: above, below, or both.
sheet.forNote: How long the reading has to stay past the line before the alarm is raised. 0 raises it at once.
sheet.forRunningNote: How long the output has to run without a pause before that is an alarm rather than a cycle.
sheet.routingNone: Not announced: nothing is routed for {{severity}} in your notification settings.
sheet.infoNote: An info alarm is written to the diary and never announced.
sheet.tunnelNote: For a target on the local network, which the device can reach and the cloud cannot.
sheet.repeatNote: While it lasts, every so many minutes; 0 says it once.
sheet.deleteAsk: The rule is gone for good. An alert it has already raised stays in the inbox.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.add: + Reminder · every N days · once · chore
tasks.sources: Sources: watering rhythm, feeding scheme, grow plan, chores, plan suggestions. A task done here writes the diary entry with the same defaults as the Log sheet.

sheet.label: What to do
sheet.nowhere: Nothing to remind about yet · start a grow or add a space first
sheet.deleteAsk: The rhythm stops and its open tasks go with it. Diary lines already written stay.

targets.title: Manual targets
targets.nothing: Nothing standing here states a climate, so there is nothing to set.
targets.prefill: Prefill from a preset, then adjust anything:
targets.planRunning: The plan running here would put its own targets back within the hour. Saving pauses it.
targets.planPaused: The plan is paused while manual targets are on.
targets.sentNote: The controller acknowledges no setting, so what it is running is not reported back.
targets.readOnly: This session may look and not set.

push.noKey: this install has no push key
push.denied: Permission was not given, so nothing can be pushed to this browser.

telegram.linked: linked {{date}} · alarms, weekly recap, log by replying
telegram.noBot: this install has no Telegram bot

webhook.headersHint: One per line, as Name: value
webhook.urlNeeded: enter a URL to switch on

grid.note: A channel is off until it is configured, and its column cannot be moved until then.

quiet.offLine: everything comes through as it happens

maintenance.sent: Asked. The device holds its alarms for 15 min once it hears.
maintenance.unheard: Nobody was listening: the device has not been heard from, so the command waits for it.

alerts.note: One line per event, graded by severity, never one push per sensor. Critical repeats until resolved; warnings once; info stays in this list only.
alerts.nothingWatching: Nothing is watching yet. Alerts come from a controller's alarm rules and from a cam.
alerts.demoNoInbox: The demo has no inbox; open a tent to see its alarms.
